container: background-color: #f0f4f8; padding: 40px 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #ffffff; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(74,124,155,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(74,124,155,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(74,124,155,0.08); border-radius: 14px; padding: 25px; margin: 0 0 40px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(58,65,80,0.06), 0 0 16px rgba(74,124,155,0.15)
h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #3d6a8a; margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(74,124,155,0.3)
h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #3d6a8a; margin: 26px 0 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid #4a7c9b; display: inline-block
blockquote: background-color: #e8f0f8; border-left: 5px solid #4a7c9b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(74,124,155,0.08); padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #5a6472; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8
pre: background-color: #eef3f8; border: 1px solid rgba(74,124,155,0.2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 18px
code: color: #3a4150; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #e8f0f8; color: #3d6a8a; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
th: background-color: #e8f0f8; color: #3d6a8a; border: 1px solid rgba(74,124,155,0.18); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700
td: border: 1px solid rgba(74,124,155,0.18); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #3a4150
